# Protonation Report — Format Reference

**Generated by:** `revision/protonation/protonate.py`
**Protocol:** pH 7.4 protonation applied to all Flexi-JEGNN input datasets
**Log format:** JSON-Lines (`.jsonl`) — one JSON object per line, one line per molecule / file processed

---

## 1. Log File Layout

The log is written by calling `write_log(path)` at the end of a run (or incrementally
between batches).  Each line is a self-contained JSON record and can be loaded with:

```python
import json, pandas as pd

records = [json.loads(line) for line in open("protonate_run.jsonl")]
df = pd.DataFrame(records)
```

---

## 2. Record Schema

Every record has the following fields regardless of pipeline (SMILES / SDF / PDB).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `input_id` | string | The raw input: SMILES string, or absolute path to SDF / mol2 / PDB file |
| `input_type` | string | `"smiles"` · `"sdf"` · `"mol2"` · `"pdb"` |
| `ph` | float | Target pH passed to the tool (always `7.4` in this revision) |
| `tool` | string | Tool used — see §3 |
| `tool_version` | string | Version string captured at detection time — see §3 |
| `status` | string | `"ok"` · `"unchanged"` · `"failed"` · `"skipped"` — see §4 |
| `output` | string \| null | Protonated SMILES, or path to the written output file; `null` on failure |
| `n_states_enumerated` | int | Dimorphite-DL only: total protonation states returned before picking one |
| `original_formal_charges` | string \| null | Compact charge fingerprint **before** protonation — see §5 |
| `protonated_formal_charges` | string \| null | Compact charge fingerprint **after** protonation — see §5 |
| `groups_changed` | array of strings | Human-readable list of atoms / residues whose ionisation state changed — see §6 |
| `wall_time_s` | float | Wall-clock seconds spent on this record |
| `timestamp` | string | UTC timestamp at the moment the record was created (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`) |
| `notes` | string | Free-text: tool stdout/stderr excerpts, fallback notices, or error messages |

---

## 3. Tool Provenance

### 3a. Dimorphite-DL — SMILES datasets (ADMET, BACE, HIV, BBBP)

```json
{
  "tool": "dimorphite_dl",
  "tool_version": "1.3.2"
}
```

- **Role:** Enumerates dominant protonation states of drug-like SMILES at a given pH window
  (`[ph − tolerance, ph + tolerance]`, default window `[6.4, 8.4]`).
- **Selection:** The first (most abundant) state is recorded as `output`; `n_states_enumerated`
  shows how many states Dimorphite returned in total.
- **Reference:** Ropp *et al.* J. Cheminformatics 11, 16 (2019).
  DOI: [10.1186/s13321-019-0336-9](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13321-019-0336-9)

### 3b. OpenBabel — PDBbind ligands (SDF / mol2)

```json
{
  "tool": "openbabel",
  "tool_version": "3.1.0"
}
```

- **Role:** Adds / removes hydrogens from a 3D ligand file using Gasteiger-based pKa estimates
  (`obabel -p 7.4 -h -d`).
- **Note:** Gasteiger pKa estimates are less accurate than specialised tools for proteins
  but are well-suited for drug-like ligands.
- **Reference:** O'Boyle *et al.* J. Cheminformatics 3, 33 (2011).
  DOI: [10.1186/1758-2946-3-33](https://doi.org/10.1186/1758-2946-3-33)

### 3c. PDB2PQR + PROPKA — PDBbind pocket PDB files (preferred)

```json
{
  "tool": "pdb2pqr+propka",
  "tool_version": "3.6.1"
}
```

- **Role:** Assigns residue-level protonation states using the empirical PROPKA 3 algorithm,
  then writes an AMBER-force-field PQR; `obabel` converts PQR → PDB for downstream use.
- **PROPKA reference:** Olsson *et al.* J. Chem. Theory Comput. 7, 525–537 (2011).
  DOI: [10.1021/ct100578z](https://doi.org/10.1021/ct100578z)
- **pdb2pqr reference:** Jurrus *et al.* Protein Sci. 27, 112–128 (2018).
  DOI: [10.1002/pro.3280](https://doi.org/10.1002/pro.3280)

### 3d. OpenBabel fallback — PDBbind pocket PDB files

```json
{
  "tool": "openbabel",
  "tool_version": "3.1.0"
}
```

Used automatically when pdb2pqr is not installed.  The `notes` field will contain the
string `"obabel -p used (Gasteiger pKa estimates; less accurate than PROPKA for proteins)"`.

---

## 4. Status Codes

| `status` | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"ok"` | Protonation applied; `output` differs from `input_id`; charge fingerprints recorded |
| `"unchanged"` | Tool ran successfully but determined no ionisation state change at this pH (molecule already at the correct state) |
| `"failed"` | Tool error, timeout, or invalid input; `output` is `null`; see `notes` for reason |
| `"skipped"` | Record was never submitted to the tool (e.g. file not found before dispatch) |

---

## 5. Charge Fingerprint Format

`original_formal_charges` and `protonated_formal_charges` are compact strings encoding
all non-zero formal charges on the molecule, computed via RDKit after sanitisation.

**Format:** `<Symbol><sign><charge>@<atomIdx>` entries joined by `,`

| Example fingerprint | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"neutral"` | No atom has a non-zero formal charge |
| `"N+1@2"` | Atom 2 is nitrogen with formal charge +1 (protonated amine) |
| `"O-1@7"` | Atom 7 is oxygen with formal charge −1 (deprotonated carboxylate) |
| `"N+1@2,O-1@7"` | Both of the above simultaneously |
| `""` (empty string) | RDKit was unavailable or SMILES could not be parsed |

---

## 6. `groups_changed` Array

Each element is a plain-English string describing one ionisation-state change.

### SMILES / SDF records (RDKit diff)

```json
"groups_changed": [
  "atom@2: neutral → N+1",
  "atom@7: O-1 → neutral"
]
```

### PDB pocket records — PROPKA residue-level output

```json
"groups_changed": [
  "ASP57A: pKa=3.84 → deprotonated at pH 7.4",
  "HIS214A: pKa=7.91 → protonated at pH 7.4",
  "GLU103A: pKa=4.12 → deprotonated at pH 7.4"
]
```

An **empty array** `[]` means the tool ran but reported no ionisation changes, or the
charge comparison was unavailable (RDKit not installed / file parse error).

---

## 7. Example Records

### 7a. SMILES — Dimorphite-DL, state changed

```json
{
  "input_id": "CC(=O)Nc1ccc(cc1)S(=O)(=O)N",
  "input_type": "smiles",
  "ph": 7.4,
  "tool": "dimorphite_dl",
  "tool_version": "1.3.2",
  "status": "ok",
  "output": "CC(=O)Nc1ccc(cc1)S(=O)(=O)[NH-]",
  "n_states_enumerated": 2,
  "original_formal_charges": "neutral",
  "protonated_formal_charges": "N-1@14",
  "groups_changed": [
    "atom@14: neutral → N-1"
  ],
  "wall_time_s": 0.021,
  "timestamp": "2026-07-30T04:15:01Z",
  "notes": ""
}
```

### 7b. SMILES — Dimorphite-DL, already at correct state

```json
{
  "input_id": "c1ccc(cc1)C",
  "input_type": "smiles",
  "ph": 7.4,
  "tool": "dimorphite_dl",
  "tool_version": "1.3.2",
  "status": "unchanged",
  "output": "c1ccc(cc1)C",
  "n_states_enumerated": 1,
  "original_formal_charges": "neutral",
  "protonated_formal_charges": "neutral",
  "groups_changed": [],
  "wall_time_s": 0.008,
  "timestamp": "2026-07-30T04:15:02Z",
  "notes": ""
}
```

### 7c. SDF ligand — OpenBabel, state changed

```json
{
  "input_id": "refined-set/1abc/1abc_ligand.sdf",
  "input_type": "sdf",
  "ph": 7.4,
  "tool": "openbabel",
  "tool_version": "3.1.0",
  "status": "ok",
  "output": "revised_data/pdbbind_H/1abc/1abc_ligand_H.sdf",
  "n_states_enumerated": 0,
  "original_formal_charges": "N+1@3",
  "protonated_formal_charges": "neutral",
  "groups_changed": [
    "atom@3: N+1 → neutral"
  ],
  "wall_time_s": 0.143,
  "timestamp": "2026-07-30T04:15:44Z",
  "notes": "obabel output: 1 molecule converted"
}
```

### 7d. PDB pocket — PDB2PQR + PROPKA, multiple residues changed

```json
{
  "input_id": "refined-set/1abc/1abc_pocket.pdb",
  "input_type": "pdb",
  "ph": 7.4,
  "tool": "pdb2pqr+propka",
  "tool_version": "3.6.1",
  "status": "ok",
  "output": "revised_data/pdbbind_H/1abc/1abc_pocket_H.pdb",
  "n_states_enumerated": 0,
  "original_formal_charges": null,
  "protonated_formal_charges": null,
  "groups_changed": [
    "ASP57A: pKa=3.84 → deprotonated at pH 7.4",
    "HIS214A: pKa=7.91 → protonated at pH 7.4",
    "GLU103A: pKa=4.12 → deprotonated at pH 7.4"
  ],
  "wall_time_s": 2.817,
  "timestamp": "2026-07-30T04:15:47Z",
  "notes": "pdb2pqr+propka succeeded; PQR converted to PDB via obabel. 3 residue(s) changed ionisation state."
}
```

### 7e. Failure — file not found

```json
{
  "input_id": "refined-set/9xyz/9xyz_ligand.sdf",
  "input_type": "sdf",
  "ph": 7.4,
  "tool": "openbabel",
  "tool_version": "3.1.0",
  "status": "failed",
  "output": null,
  "n_states_enumerated": 0,
  "original_formal_charges": null,
  "protonated_formal_charges": null,
  "groups_changed": [],
  "wall_time_s": 0.001,
  "timestamp": "2026-07-30T04:16:03Z",
  "notes": "Exception: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'refined-set/9xyz/9xyz_ligand.sdf'"
}
```

## 8. Summary Statistics (computed from the log)

After loading the log into a DataFrame, the following summary block should appear in the
final revision report:

```
Protonation summary — pH 7.4
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Dataset / file type     Total    ok    unchanged    failed    skipped
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ADMET   (SMILES)         7,278   ???       ???       ???         0
BACE    (SMILES)         1,513   ???       ???       ???         0
BBBP    (SMILES)         2,039   ???       ???       ???         0
HIV     (SMILES)        41,127   ???       ???       ???         0
PDBbind ligands  (SDF)   5,316   ???       ???       ???       ???
PDBbind pockets  (PDB)   5,316   ???       ???       ???       ???
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Tool versions used:
  dimorphite_dl : ???
  openbabel     : ???
  pdb2pqr+propka: ???  (or "not available — obabel fallback used")
```

> [!NOTE]
> The `???` placeholders above are filled in automatically once the protonation run
> completes.  The script `revision/protonation/summarise_log.py` (to be created) will
> generate this table from the `.jsonl` log file.

---

## 9. Downstream Use

The protonated outputs are consumed by revised experiment pipelines as follows:

| Dataset | Original input to experiments/ | Revised input (after protonation) |
|---|---|---|
| ADMET, BACE, BBBP, HIV | `SMILES` column in raw CSV | `smiles_ph74` column in revised CSV |
| PDBbind ligands | `<pdbid>_ligand.sdf` | `revised_data/pdbbind_H/<pdbid>/<pdbid>_ligand_H.sdf` |
| PDBbind pockets | `<pdbid>_pocket.pdb` | `revised_data/pdbbind_H/<pdbid>/<pdbid>_pocket_H.pdb` |

The revised experiment scripts in `revision/experiments/` read from the protonated files;
the original files in `datasets/` and `refined-set/` are **never modified**.

---

## 10. Reproducibility Checklist

Before submitting the revision, confirm:

- [ ] `tool_version` values are identical across all records in a given log file
      (ensures the run used a single tool version throughout)
- [ ] No record has `status == "failed"` with `tool_version == "unknown"`
      (would indicate a version detection error; re-run after verifying installation)
- [ ] `n_states_enumerated == 0` records are limited to non-SMILES pipelines
      (SDF / PDB — Dimorphite is not used for these)
- [ ] The `notes` field for every PDB pocket record mentions either
      `"pdb2pqr+propka succeeded"` or `"obabel -p used (Gasteiger pKa estimates"` —
      the latter should be flagged and, where possible, replaced with a PROPKA run
- [ ] Log file is committed to the repository alongside the protonated data files
